const enabled = true;
const flagged = { [enabled]: 1 };
const key = { id: 1 };
const keyed = { [key]: "value" };
const method = { [enabled]() { return 1; } };
const getter = { get [key]() { return 1; } };
class Flagged { [enabled]() { return 1; } }
const unknownKey: unknown = 1;
const fromUnknown = { [unknownKey]: 1 };
const either: string | number = Number("1") > 0.5 ? "a" : 1;
const fromEither = { [either]: 1 };
const missing: undefined = undefined;
const fromMissing = { [missing]: 1 };
function make<T extends PropertyKey, U>(t: T, u: U) { return { [t]: 1, [u]: 2 }; }
const big = { [10n]: 1 };
const loose: any = "k";
const fromAny = { [loose]: 1, [Symbol("s")]: 2, ["s"]: 3, [4]: 5 };
console.log(flagged, keyed, method, getter, new Flagged(), fromUnknown, fromEither, fromMissing, make("a", "b"), big, fromAny);
